WITH o AS (SELECT search_id,session_id,total_result_count,LEAD(total_result_count) OVER(PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY search_sequence,search_time,search_id) nxt,search_sequence FROM Search),z AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY search_sequence,search_id) zr FROM o WHERE total_result_count=0) SELECT SUM(zr=1 AND nxt>0),SUM(zr=1 AND nxt IS NOT NULL) FROM z

WITH o AS (SELECT session_id,total_result_count,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY search_sequence DESC,search_time DESC,search_id DESC) rn,MAX(total_result_count=0) OVER(PARTITION BY session_id) z FROM Search) SELECT SUM(rn=1 AND z=1 AND total_result_count>0),SUM(rn=1 AND z=1) FROM o
